notes.title: Sales report
notes.notes:
Good evening, we are from Ukraine)

Today we were in the volunteer center in the city of Cherkasy where migrants and refugees evacuated from the temporarily occupied territories gather. We took a list of goods they need. These are mostly medicines that are not always delivered due to difficult logistics and lack of fuel.
These are anti-allergic, antipyretic and sedative pills, drops and more. For the rest of the money we took food that is also not always enough: pasta, tea, canned food and more.
As promised, we know part of the money for the needs of those who need it.
In the future, depending on the amount of sales of the game, we will try to continue to help as much as we can.
You can see the full image by following the link [url=https://twitter.com/whowear22701559/status/1531012997942226944]Twitter[/url] and this [url=https://twitter.com/whowear22701559/status/1531013666019196937]Twitter[/url]

If you have any questions, we will be happy to answer them.

Thank you all for your support, everything will be Ukraine!

notes.title: Game release! Thanks everyone!
notes.notes:
So the time came for the full release of the game and it happened. We want to say [b]a big thank you to everyone[/b], for buying our game and supporting us and Ukraine. [b]We, as promised, will send humanitarian aid to Ukraine[/b] and all this is thanks to YOU! The game does not cost that much, but everyone who bought it helped Ukrainians in need of humanitarian assistance. [i]I also want to remind you that our team is Ukrainian[/i] and we see it for everyone, we live here and it’s hard for all of us, but together we are strong and together we can survive and live. [b] Thank you all! Glory to Ukraine![/b]

notes.title: Announcement for all buyers
notes.notes:
Welcome all. We are a small team from war-torn Ukraine. In the last month, we have experienced a lot, part of our team is volunteers and we had an idea how to take a break from the events and laugh a little at this difficult time.
We made a small satirical project that makes fun of and refers to many things that have happened recently, the project is designed to cheer you up in these troubled days and do a small but good deed. [u]Half of the money earned from the game will go to help the residents affected by the Russian occupation[/u], who were left without their homes and the Ukrainian military, who defend their land, their home with resolute stamina. This money will be spent on food, medicine and shelter for people who have been forced to leave their homes. We will definitely report where and how the funds were spent! War brings people together and we are grateful to everyone for their support. [b]Glory to Ukraine![/b]
